sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Anonymous charcoal-gradient peaked-cap bust on textured warm grey backing. Cap has a small brim projecting screen left and a broad drooping crown extending screen right; face outline looks screen left. Broad cropped shoulders and a short dark neck, no interior facial/hair/uniform details visible.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Distinct anonymous charcoal-gradient military-cap bust on textured grey-beige backing. Rounded cap crown extends screen left and a short visor projects screen right; broad front/three-quarter bust and sloping shoulders. No visible eyes, facial hair, hairstyle, insignia or garment detail.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Distinct anonymous female military-cap bust silhouette in grey-black gradient on pale grey textured backing. Cap brim and facial contour face screen left; broad cap crown and rounded rear head contour extend screen right. Cropped shoulders; all face, hair and clothing interior remain concealed.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Anonymous fedora/trench-coat silhouette in grey-black gradient on textured grey-brown full backing. Tall slightly tapered crown, wide brim projecting both sides, head contour generally looks screen left, turned-up lapel/collar silhouette and broad cropped shoulders. No visible interior face/hair/cloth detail.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Vivid magenta-purple and green development placeholder with central teal helmeted/masked figure. Green diagonal stripe across teal helmet; dark breathing-mask/respirator with teal projecting lower hose/equipment; large white PLACE row over upper helmet and HOLD row across middle face. Other cropped background lettering/marks at top and bottom stay as actually present. No identity inferred from filename.
